COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1008 of 2022
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
Mr. Aditya Singh, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the
respondent.
Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
Petitioners are plaintiffs in Original
Suit No. 560 of 2018. Learned trial
Court on 12.01.2022 granted tem porary
injunction in their favour, restraining the
defendant, his servants, agents, legal
representatives etc. from interfering in
peaceful possession of the plaintiffs.
Defendant filed a Misc. Appeal under
Order 43 Rule 1 (r) C.P.C. Learned
District Judge, Dehradun vide order
dated 18.01.2022 stayed the effect &
operation of the order of tem porary
injunction passed by learned trial Court.
Thus, feeling aggrieved, petitioners have
approached this Court.

I t is contended by learned counsel
for the petitioners that petitioners had
filed caveat and learned District Judge
vide order dated 18.01.2022 directed the
appellant (respondent herein) to ensure
service of copy of the Appeal to the
caveator, within three days. He further
submits that by the sam e order, learned
District Judge stayed the effect &
operation of the order of tem porary
injunction passed by learned Trial Court.
Learned counsel for the
respondent/ defendant, however, submits
that, due to Covid-19 Protocol, copy of
the Appeal was not officially served upon
the caveator and it was left in the
cham ber of learned counsel appearing
for the caveator, before filing the appeal.
Learned counsel for respondent has
apprised the Court that hearing of the
Appeal is concluded and judgment has
been reserved. Thus, he submits that
the writ petition has now becom e
infructuous, as the interim order,
impugned in this writ petition, would
m erge in the final order.

Since judgm ent has been reserved
by learned Appellate Court in
Miscellaneous Civil Appeal No. 06 of
2022, therefore, any interference with
the impugned order, at this stage, would
be unwarranted. Till delivery of judgment
by learned Appellate Court in the Appeal,
parties shall not interfere in the peaceful
possession of the other party.
The writ petition is, accordingly,
disposed of.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 19.05.2022
Arpan
